scope: TensorRT EdgeCrafter-seg-s app gate on Jetson Orin ARM64 (TRT 10.16.2); promotes the TRT cell of `Instance segmentation (ecseg, edgecrafter_seg)` from B to P. P covers this model + environment only.

build.flags: -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DDEFAULT_BACKEND=TENSORRT (existing build-nano-trt dir; not a fresh configure)
build.export: EdgeCrafter repo (Intellindust-AI-Lab, depth-1 clone) ecdetseg/tools/deployment/export_onnx.py -c configs/ecseg/ecseg_s.yml -r ecseg_s.pth --check --simplify; checkpoint ecseg_s.pth from capsule2077/edgecrafter releases; venv torch 2.15 + unpinned modern deps (sibling pins ml_dtypes==0.2.0/numpy==2.0.1, which do not build on py3.12)

gate.checked: render inspected: dog and car instance masks follow object contours precisely with correct boxes on dog.jpg. Native EdgeCrafter ONNX (exact-GELU) converts and runs on TRT 10.16 — the GELU import problem is DNN-backend-specific.
